S.FORM: alang Takofan ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Ku'ang sang go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 359 buwan, 1,048 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 55% kyan ku 578 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 45% kyan ku 470 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 52%, saySiyat 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Takofan hya' ga wsilung krahu'. tay 'zil na Takofan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Takofan hya' ga Kano go. tay mkraya' na Takofan hya' ga Chishang. tay mkyahu' na Takofan hya' ga Parupu. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ tako*an ɣa nija mki s~ɕku tajto keŋ atu kuʔaŋ s~ɕaŋ ɣo, kwara s~ɕali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan, *,*** ħi ku kwara s~ɕʔuli tajan. s~ɕʔuli tajan pins~ɕpŋan ɣjenʦ~ʨumin ɣa **% kjan ku *** ħi, βinaħ ɣa, ʔjat kaħun s~ɕku pins~ɕpŋan ɣjenʦ~ʨumin ɣa **% kjan ku *** ħi nja. pins~ɕpuŋ na linħujan ɣjenʦ~ʨumin ɣa, amis~ɕ **%, s~ɕajs~ɕijat *%, βinaħ liħujan s~ɕʔuli *%. rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na tako*an ħjaʔ ɣa ws~ɕiluŋ kraħuʔ. taj ʔzil na tako*an ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ. taj mkjaħuʔ na tako*an ħjaʔ ɣa kano ɣo. taj mkrajaʔ na tako*an ħjaʔ ɣa ʦ~ʨħis~ɕħaŋ. taj mkjaħuʔ na tako*an ħjaʔ ɣa parupu. rekis~ɕi kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj. s~ɕs~ɕquliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwas~ɕan βiru ʔlaqiʔ ʦ~ʨikuj maki * pqwas~ɕan βiru ʔlaqiʔ ʦ~ʨikuj. tuqi ʔs~ɕan βas~ɕu kis~ɕjaʔ ɣlɣan s~ɕpjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
